name: 0.security
long_description:
0.security builds an autonomous offensive security team that finds and fixes vulnerabilities as fast as AI writes code and before attackers exploit them.

We've found and fixed dozens of previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in government software across multiple countries and in software running on 3+ billion devices. Today we work with EY (Ernst & Young), leading tech companies and defense organizations.

Our AI agents hack into any software, verify every vulnerability they find, and ship the fix. They run 24/7 across the full stack, from web apps and dependencies down to operating systems and the Linux kernel.

We offer two products: 0cloud, where developer teams connect their repos and get security handled 24/7 at the speed of their coding agents, and our open-source harness, which we deploy & run for tech companies, enterprises and critical infrastructure providers.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder & CEO at 0.security, previously cyber defense engineer at the largest Swiss conglomerate retailer. Doruk was a Swiss finalist at the math & logic games championship at the age of 14, and won the Swiss startup 2026 award. In 2009, he accidentally installed a virus on the computer of his father while trying to download Minecraft. He's been interested in computers and security ever since.
